attempts.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified functionally by manual invocation, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/state, rebooted node1 safely, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified cron service, crontab entry, and log file all recovered intact.
